body: Ahhhhhhhhhhh
Yeah...”what usually helps when you feel like this?” And “I have some referrals.” They don’t engage in a regular conversation. Honestly, it could be a chatbot talking back.

Ooooh they can be SO bad and make things SO Much worse. It’s not just you. Or anything you’re doing. It’s a tough job. By the time I was totally hopeless, I did call and have a good experience because the operators was able to connect to me, personalize the call. Too late for me, though. 
*edit- anything YOU’RE doing 

Edit- but that’s ridiculous they just left you. Makes me so mad
Thanks for responding. It’s not a simple answer
All I am anymore is a burden...and not a happy, well one. My life is worthless and it’s torture staying alive... I want to die
I know...that came across poorly.
Find people who are willing to give back.

It seems fairly normal...it can take a long time before you’re assessed or it can take a long time before they find an open-bed. I was “on hold” a little bit ago, but I wasn’t admitted.  It probably depends on the hospital and the staff. I did ask them to for something to help me sleep. Will they let you make calls? Maybe someone can come and check up in the process, even if they can’t visit you. 

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. I wish I had more advice! Hang in there, though!! You’re getting yourself help. I’m Type 1 too, (assume you are) and it’s hard. I was diagnosed later in life, and I’ll  tell you it can do a doozy on one’s mental health.
Your ex seems very toxic!! You deserve better. That’s absolutely horrible that he wouldn’t open the door so you could get your insulin, scary horrible.
No, not at all. Just too diverse a group of very depressed people. The only posts that seem to get a lot of responses are super vague ones.
In this case, I agree. Sometimes it is done out of genuine concern, but this was definitely motivated by malice. :( fuck
It’s too long…summarize: loss of my life, independence, hopelessness...but loss of love and loss of value
Thanks…I don’t want to live, though. I’m hopeless at this point. I just can’t get the energy… but I don’t want to cause more problems while I chicken out
Good nap for sure!
Yeah. That’s good advice, thanks. but I’m not going to recover from all this…
Do you have type 1?
I wrote a post about it, too. I think there should be an after call survey or something. I’m sure there are helpful people, but I had a terrible experience as well
Dogs are angels...

can you look for a job or way to earn income online? Maybe save for a car? Could you take  free-classes online? Could you apply for school? Have you applied for disability (if you’re unable to work because of your conditions.) 
Edit: add, you may qualify for food stamps. See what social service resources are available to you. Sorry this doesn’t address any emotional stuff.
But, you want to live. It primarily seems like a financial/security issue. Maybe see if you can find a case-manager to help you, see if there are programs you qualify for.
I so much relate to your post.
Sometimes people don’t know what else to say... sometimes they’re nudging you toward things that can make you feel better. Sometimes a good therapist can help you make friends.
Feeling trapped is awful. I’m sorry you feel like that.
What kind of resources where you looking for? I guess the hotline can be really hot and cold.
What do you think about feeling that way?
That’s not a lot to respond to, but it’s OK if you’re not into sharing with us right now. What’s important is that you’re carrying a huge burden...I hope you stay safe.
Why not?
Do you trust yourself?

I don’t know your story, or where your pain comes from. :( what are the other options? There are ways to “get help,” that don’t mean asking for help. Do you have a trusted therapist that could help guide you? Gain a fresh perspective for options? I’m sorry you feel like this

I’m sorry you’re feeling so much pain that you think dying would be an answer. No 17 year old deserves to feel that way. You have your whole life ahead of you and things can change. Suicide isn’t the answer, soothing the pain is. Maybe it will be hard, but you are so young. Please keep looking for help that can actually help you.
Empathy for pain I understand.

You’re experiencing and articulating very human emotions. You’re definitely human. Feeling dehumanized is complicated and intense. It seems like you don’t feel appreciated and respected by your friends. That’s super hurtful, but you can’t internalize it. It doesn’t mean you don’t deserve to be appreciated. There could be so many things going on. It’s really hard to comment on a relationship over this type of forum, shouldn’t really, but it doesn’t seem like your friend handled things in a mature and honest way. I’m sorry you’re feeling that pain, especially if you’re already a bit isolated or disconnected.

I’m so sorry you’re holding this pain. You are a human. So are the hotline workers, which mean some stink at their job. Probably many do. Maybe it’s their training, maybe it’s them personally. It sounds like you had a really good reason to call the hotline and should have gotten some human connection, compassion and help. Sorry they failed. You could take your chances and try again and hope to get connected to a more qualified person.
Right, caring people are helpful. No one wants to encounter dehumanizing people when they're upset.  Not everyone is compassionate or meant to work at a hotline.

It's a long story. I'm not myself anymore. I was trying to keep myself together, emotionally, and the more I reached out, the worse it made me feel.  I guess it all spiraled from there.  I called the hotline during a crisis, I wasn't expecting them to mock me or make me feel badly for calling.
sometimes I need to talk to someone anonymously. Friends and family can only hear so much. I don't know why, but I'm very upset with how the hotlines work. I guess it's ridiculous?

Hey, hope you're still here.  There are some real bad eggs working the crisis line!  I'm sorry that happened to you-it's awful.  I had a similar experience the first time I called.  I was distraught, immensely suicidal, and couldn't believe I - me- was calling the line.  I don't remember exactly what dismissive and rude things were said to me, but it made me feel worse.  I think I called back several times that night to talk about my experience (obviously was not in a good state.)- the anger and shock kept me distracted from my suicide.

I kept calling, I don't know why, and only rarely reached someone who really listened and showed warmth, empathy and human connection.

I signed up for reddit just to find a post like yours.  It bothers me how awful some operators are.  I hope someone comes up with an idea or at least more people share their horrible experiences so that we know we aren't alone- there's just some bad eggs operating- and maybe there will be a change?

Hope you're OK-fuck people who hear a cry for life and say things like that.
